dxgd7r6k.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink - 150 cm
dxgd7r6k.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink - 150 cm
dxgd7r6k.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

vymnet6f.baseName: Neo Luxury Christmas Wreath with Red Berries Baubles and Pine Cones
vymnet6f.variantName: Neo Luxury Christmas Wreath with Red Berries Baubles and Pine Cones
vymnet6f.sourceDescription: Bring traditional festive style to your home with this luxury artificial Christmas wreath, beautifully decorated with lush evergreen foliage, vibrant red berries, natural-look pine cones, glossy red baubles and contrasting dark green ornaments. Designed to create a full, layered appearance, this decorative wreath adds an elegant seasonal touch to front doors, fireplaces, walls, hallways and table centrepieces. The realistic mixed greenery and classic red and green colour palette make it easy to coordinate with both traditional and contemporary Christmas décor. Reusable year after year, it offers a simple way to create a warm and welcoming festive display throughout your home. •Luxury Festive Design: A full and beautifully layered Christmas wreath featuring realistic evergreen foliage, red berry sprays, pine cones, glossy red baubles and elegant dark green decorations. •Classic Christmas Colours: Rich green foliage combined with vibrant red accents creates a timeless festive look that complements traditional, rustic and modern Christmas decorations. •Versatile Christmas Decoration: Ideal for styling on front doors, internal doors, walls, fireplaces and mantelpieces, or use flat as an attractive Christmas table centrepiece. •Realistic Full and Layered Appearance: Mixed artificial pine branches and decorative foliage create depth and texture, giving the wreath a naturally full and premium appearance. •Reusable Season Décor: An artificial design that can be carefully stored after Christmas and brought out again each festive season, making it a practical addition to your Christmas decoration collection. This product is intended for decorative purposes only and is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets. Small or detachable decorative components, including berries, baubles, pine cones and foliage, may present a choking hazard. Keep away from naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other heat or ignition sources. Ensure the wreath is securely attached when displayed on doors, walls or other elevated surfaces to prevent it from falling. Do not place directly above or close to an active fireplace. Regularly inspect for loose, damaged or detached components and discontinue use if damaged. Protect from prolonged exposure to adverse weather conditions. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
